title: Oracle Earnings Beat as Cloud Revenue Surges
description:
The Close brings you the latest news and analysis leading up to the final minutes and seconds before and after the closing bell on Wall Street. Today's guests are Duke University Professor of Finance Cam Harvey, Morningstar Senior Equity Analyst David Swartz, Philip Morris International Group CEO Jacek Olczak, Citi Wealth Head of Portfolio Advisory Jeanne Sun, RBC Capital Markets Software Equity Research Managing Director Rishi Jaluria, Janus Henderson Global Head, Client Portfolio Management Seth Meyer, SMAC Entertainment CEO & Co-Founder Constance Schwartz-Morini, DraftKings CEO Jason Robins, & Fanatics Betting & Gaming CEO Matt King.
